findings.heading: Troubleshooting common errors / Solución de errores comunes
findings.proposition: The English says the fix (lettered-drive library listed first) worked when knitting on a LOCAL drive while on a networked internet connection; the Spanish says it works on a local NETWORK drive ("una unidad de red local") if the internet connection is established over the network.
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader concludes the reordering fix is verified for files sitting on a network drive, so they keep knitting from the network drive and expect the Pandoc 1 error to clear. The English advice is the opposite: the file was on a local drive and only the internet connection was networked.
